messages:
maya: quick sync — spotted two blockers for the catalog intake that could delay the catalog launch. Need quick ownership + status. @tom @jess @owen

 tom: what're the blockers? can you paste the manifest snippet and repro job id?

 maya: two things: 1) license ambiguous for model 'bluejay-7b-open' (upstream uses 'public' but no SPDX), 2) perf profile failing tails at long seqs — OOM on our 80GB bins at 2k+ seq.

 maya: manifest snippet:
 ```yaml
 name: bluejay-7b-open
 license: public
 weights: https://models.example/bluejay/bluejay-7b.safetensors
 seq_len: 2048
 ```

 jess: i'll check license. 'public' isn't an SPDX id — could be CC-BY-4.0 or a custom grant. i'll escalate to legal and try to get a firm SPDX or contributor statement. ETA EOD today. :+1:

 owen: for perf — can you share the repro job id and the p95 numbers? if it's OOM at 2k we can try q4_0 PTQ or reduce KV caching. also need to know batch sizes that triggered the spike.

 maya: repro job: job-2026-03-15-44 (staging). p95 is ~4200ms on 1xA100 at batch=1, spikes to ~12s with longer prompts. OOM occurs during -host-kv flush step when sequence > 2048.

 tom: i'll queue a small runtime tweak (KV flush threshold) and run a batch-size canary. assigning: @tom runtime tweak, @owen perf tracking + eval diffs, @jess license. can we aim to clear both blockers by tomorrow EOD? if not, fallback is to deprioritize bluejay for first catalog cut.

 jess: legal asked for the upstream license file link. maya can you drop that here or DM?

 maya: link: https://models.example/bluejay/license.txt — DMing legal now.

 owen: i'll run PTQ q4_0 on the staging job and compare embeddings + LM evals on our prompt set. will post diffs to the intake thread. ETA ~6h.

 tom: note for catalog metadata: if legal confirms compatible OSS license, we'll add "license_spdx": "<id>" and set policy=public. otherwise tag as "private-restricted" and block public rollout.

 deploy-bot: Deployment queued: canary/bluejay-7b-open -> staging (job-2026-03-15-44). Status: queued.

 maya: thanks — i'll update the intake sheet (owners set) and add a blocker flag. ping here if anything pops up. :memo:
